control.title: Service requirements: Public event permit request
control.reviewCycle: On every change to the service

paragraphs: This document describes the requirements of a sample e-service that lets an applicant request a permit to hold a public event and follow the request until a decision is issued.
The document is an anonymised example; every name and number in it is invented.
• Filling in the request form and attaching the required documents.
• Review of the request by the responsible officer.
• Issuing the decision and notifying the applicant.
The table below lists the basic data of the service.
The following fees are collected when the request is filed.

rows: A request is not accepted until every required attachment is uploaded.
The event date must be at least seven days after the filing date.
The applicant is notified on every change of the request status.

items.name: File a permit request
items.want: to fill in the request form and attach the documents
items.so: I obtain a permit to hold the event
acceptance: The form shows every required field.
The request cannot be sent before the required attachments are uploaded.
The request number is shown after sending.

rows: The request stays with the applicant
The announced name of the event
The first day of the event

items.name: Review the request
items.want: to review the request and its attachments
acceptance: The officer sees all request data and attachments.
The officer can approve, reject or return the request for changes.

rows: The request is closed and the applicant notified
The request goes back to the applicant
